set.body: Extract the common latent-space, MatrixMap, scores, scale, and diagnostics construction used by PLSC and regularized CCA. Acceptance: current Plsc.fit and Cca.fit entry points remain source-compatible; PLSC uses covariance-operator SVD, CCA uses typed regularization and whitened-operator SVD; existing tests still pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar: factor PLSC and CCA through paired latent builder
